title: Large Scale Crowdsourcing and Characterization of Twitter Abusive Behavior
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical methodology for crowdsourcing a large dataset of abusive behavior on Twitter. While it deals with concepts like 'hate speech' and 'abusive language' (which have ethical dimensions), it does not contain a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics as specified in the instructions; rather, it is a data collection and characterization study.
